title: Research token trace v1
description: One generated continuation before firewall policy. A consumer links decisions using (trace_id, position). Additional fields may carry experimental annotations.

layer.description: Zero-based transformer block index. Scoring reads the post-block residual at the candidate token.

probe_id.description: SHA-256 of the exact probe.json bytes.

tokens.description: Completion tokens only, in sequence. Each token's position must equal its array index; the Python validator checks this cross-item constraint.

token_id.description: Candidate ID in the identified tokenizer's vocabulary.

text.description: The incremental decoded fragment. Concatenate fragments in position order to display the continuation without adding spaces. A token that supplies only part of a character, or a special token with no visible output, may have an empty fragment.

risk_score.description: Probe sigmoid score for the unsupported label, available after evaluating the candidate internally and before its release. This is an experimental association with the benchmark label.
